title: ETHUSDT EMA Trend Gate - Cross-Asset Generalization Test
objective: Test whether EMA Trend Gate strategy (proven on BTC with 0.998 OOS Sharpe) generalizes to ETHUSDT with multi-year deep history
hypothesis: The 4h EMA trend gate filtering 1h RSI mean-reversion signals, which achieved 0.998 OOS Sharpe on BTC, will produce similarly robust results on ETHUSDT
key_findings: EMA Trend Gate generalizes to ETHUSDT but with lower Sharpe than BTC baseline
OOS Sharpe 0.489 is below 0.8 gate but above minimum threshold
Max drawdown improved from prior ETH run (-16.37% to -14.34%)
85 windows provide robust OOS validation across 7.5 years of data
Cross-asset generalization partially confirmed - strategy works but underperforms BTC
